verdict.rationale: Wise documents its own API for making business payments directly from a Wise account (wise-docs-6). It also exposes programmatic batch transfers (wise-docs-28), statement retrieval in machine-readable formats (wise-docs-27) and webhook subscription management (wise-docs-33), so core business operations can run headlessly without the UI. However, nothing addresses CI or unattended-automation use specifically, and no OpenAPI spec was found (wise-probe-2). Missing for 10: an official CLI or SDK, documented non-interactive auth (API tokens or service accounts) for automation, CI-oriented guidance or examples, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of headless use.
